== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Masons, also known as [[the House]] of Masons, are a respected order within the [[Consultant's Guild]]. Based in a gray headquarters on [[Gray Island]] that is designed to blend into its surroundings, the organization functions as an intelligence-gathering network. Their primary role is to conduct undercover infiltration by embedding trained professionals into various sectors of society. These members are educated from childhood in specific trades—such as alchemy, scholarship, or merchant work—allowing them to act as experts and insiders who relay information back to the [[Consultants]]. While they are highly skilled at maintaining covers and performing professional duties, some members struggle with the psychological toll of their work, occasionally becoming too immersed in their false identities. Although they are primarily used for information gathering rather than assassination, they are capable of violence when necessary. The order is led by a [[Yala the High Mason|High Mason]] and operates under strict guild laws. Within the broader hierarchy of the [[Consultants]], they serve as the foundation for operations, working alongside other specialized groups like the [[Architects]], Shepherds, and [[Gardeners]].}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Employed within [[Ulrich Fletcher|Fletcher]]'s Workshop{{!}}workshop, the Masons are a group of professional consultants who provide reports and local information. Operating out of a gray headquarters, these specialists relay data to the [[Consultant's Guild]] and host two hundred and thirty-seven students. Although they were once observed posing as guards while wearing long [[Blackwatch]] coats, they are recognized as vital forces that could be lost. Within their ranks, the figure known as [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] is regarded as a legend.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Masons are a group of spies who function as [[Shera]]'s operational assets, though they are not assassins. These agents appear to be ordinary-looking civilians who possess the ability to fake sleep and hide among unconscious citizens. While they are secretly part of Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius' recruits, the Masons are positioned within the [[Imperial]] Palace to spread discontent using news-sheets. [[House|The House]] of Masons is characterized by its wood-and-plaster walls.}}
